blocks.content: In responsive web design, you adjust a website's layout so it looks good on any screen size—small, medium, or large.
Here are some common changes you'll make:

items: Text and image sizes adjust to fit the screen.
Layouts shift so content looks neat on smaller or larger screens.
Specific adjustments are applied to suit different devices.

blocks.content: These changes are made with media queries, a CSS tool that helps apply certain styles based on the screen's size or other conditions.
Let's explore how media queries work.
